# MEDICAL CENTER/___ DEPARTMENT ___

# 4/40 WORKWEEK AGREEMENT COVERS FULL-TIME REGULAR EMPLOYEES

This Agreement effective ___ , modifies the Collective Bargaining Agreement between the KAISER PERMANENTE MEDICAL CARE PROGRAM (hereinafter referred to as the Employer) and ___ (hereinafter referred to as the Union) for the purposes of establishing a ten hour, four day workweek (4/40 workweek) for employees within the ___ Department.

The parties acknowledge that at least two-thirds of the affected employees have voluntarily agreed in writing to work four ten-hour shifts. (Affected employees include all employees in a readily identifiable work unit, such as a division, a department, a job classification, a shift, a separate physical location, or a recognized subdivision of any such work unit). Additionally, a secret ballot vote was conducted in accordance with Section 3B of the Industrial Welfare Commission Order 5-89. At the end of one (1) year if 1/3 of the affected employees petition for a vote to terminate this agreement, the Employer will conduct a secret ballot vote. Provided that at least 2/3 of the affected employee's vote in support of the Agreement, this Agreement may be extended.

Unless otherwise provided below, all other provisions of the Collective Bargaining Agreement shall remain in force.

a. The overtime provisions of Article ___, Paragraph _____ are waived, while the overtime provisions of Section 3 B of the California State Industrial Welfare Commission Order 5-89 remain in effect.

b. Accruals for sick leave, vacations, educational leave, etc. shall be based on forty (40) hours of work per week. For the purposes of this Agreement, one "day" as referred to in the Master Agreement is equivalent to ten (10) hours. For example, if an employee takes one vacation day, he/she will receive ten (10) hours of vacation pay.

c. For holidays only, employees covered by this Agreement shall be allowed to utilize their maximum of eighty (80) hours of holiday benefits in either ten (10) hour or eight (8) hour increments. Holidays shall be paid in accordance with the Collective Bargaining Agreement.

d. For purposes of Article ___, Section ___. Shift Differentials, the shift differential, if any, which applies at the start of the ten(10) hour shift shall remain in effect for the complete shift.
